programmes.d: When testing out a new flying machine, Mitch spots a makeshift raft with a stranded woman in it.
Prominent British businessman Richard Branson visits Baywatch to perform several risky stunts.
Hobie’s idol comes to the beach, but Mitch is furious he turns out to have some questionable morals.
Mitch considers a new career working with Garner as a private eye. Logan cheats on Caroline again.
When a crippled oil rig sinks and floods with water, the team begins a desperate rescue effort.
Kaye asks Hobie to volunteer at a school for young blind children.
Cody and Neely rescue two surfers that fall ill due to a highly polluted beach.
Mitch's mother arrives in town and, after some strange occurrences, he insists she see a doctor.
Stephanie, CJ, and Caroline go on a girls-only junior lifeguard trip to Catalina.
Hobie's new friend Isaac’s risky behavior causes problems for the lifeguards.
Logan borrows Cody's car without permission and has an accident, then lies to the police.
Matt returns to Baywatch and ends up trapped on a yacht with Neely and a group of ruthless pirates.
Logan and Caroline’s relationship hits a new low when Caroline returns his engagement ring.
Caroline blames herself for a teen's death in a fiery nighttime boating accident and gets PTSD.
A mysterious creature begins attacking beachgoers, and it is up to the Baywatch team to find it.
Logan must help his friend raise $50,000 to keep her ranch, and Jessie Lee Harris is back to help.
Stephanie, Caroline and CJ become Charlie’s Angels in a fun fantasy romp through 70's television.
CJ rescues pro wrestler Hulk Hogan, who is in town with Randy Savage to help save a Youth Center.
Mitch is convinced by Stephanie's boyfriend Tom to go sky-surfing but things go horribly wrong.
Stephanie is recruiting lifeguards for the annual Sailing Regatta against South Bay.
Mitch and Caroline rescue a woman who gets amnesia while trying to find her father.
The team is invited to Hawaii for a week to oversee new lifeguard techniques and relax a bit.
After Matt is stung by a poisonous fish they find a village where a young woman offers to help.
Kaye is reunited with old flame Wes Masters. Stephanie undergoes surgery for melanoma.
While in search of underwater treasure, Stephanie and Cody are confronted by drug smugglers.
Logan decides to write and direct a low-budget action film at the beach using a real shark.
When Mitch Judges the Miss Malibu Beach Bikini Contest his willpower is tested.
Andy, an old friend of Mitch, visits Baywatch to complete four days of lifeguard service.
Matt and CJ stumble upon a homeless man who shockingly turns out to be someone they know very well.
